oneLine: Eswari Global Metal Industries receives SEBI approval for an IPO.

sources.title: Eswari Global Metal Industries gets SEBI nod for Rs 500 crore IPO

synopsis: Eswari Global Metal Industries has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India to proceed with its initial public offering. The company plans to raise Rs 500 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares. Additionally, existing shareholders, including the promoters, will sell 1.32 crore equity shares through an offer-for-sale. The fresh issue proceeds will be utilized for expanding Phase 2 of the manufacturing facility in Mundra, Gujarat, and for debt repayment. The company may also consider raising up to Rs 100 crore through a pre-IPO placement, which would reduce the fresh issue size accordingly. DAM Capital Advisors, ICICI Securities, and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors are the merchant bankers for the public issue.
